idea-plugin.name: Merge Hell Runner
idea-plugin.description:
The build is red. The deadline is tonight. Your only escape is to run.

Merge Hell Runner is a full-blown, side-scrolling action game that lives inside your IntelliJ IDEA tool window. Stop fixing merge conflicts — outrun them. Turn every NullPointerException, every 3am on-call page, and every 800-line legacy class into a boss you can finally shoot back at.


🔥 Escape the Merge Hell 🔥

A complete 5-level campaign of industrial ruins, suspended construction, geothermal warfare, and an alien infestation — playable in the time it takes your CI pipeline to fail again.


🚀 What's inside:

  • 🗺️ 5 Distinct Missions: Run from Repository City to the Heap District, Aerial Citadel, Geothermal Foundry, and the reality-bending Alien Hive.
  • 👹 5 Unique Bosses: Break the dependency graph of the Legacy Code Monstrosity, then face the Memory Leak Daemon, Aerial Gantry Architect, Geothermal Siege Engine, and the Alien Rootheart.
  • 🧬 Level-Specific Enemies: Fight heap leaks, rail sentinels, shield wardens, cable wasps, welding drones, thermal drillers, slag crawlers, resin spitters, spore drifters, and alien pouncers.
  • 🌊 Arena Battle Zones: Clear authored squads of chapter-specific enemies while navigating suspended platforms, foundry machinery and living defenses.
  • 🔫 6-Weapon Arsenal: Choose Commit Cannon, Force Push, Rapid CI, Garbage Collector, Firewall, or Refactor Beam, with dedicated upgrades and evolutions.
  • 4 Operatives & 3 Difficulties: Pick your character and starting weapon independently, unlock the Night-shift engineer, and choose Relaxed, Standard, or Challenge.
  • Directional Combat: Eight-way aiming, crouch fire, airborne downward shots, stationary aim, and independent drone companions.
  • ⚡ Sudo Overclock & Defense: Kills and reflections charge a brief boosted barrage. Shield pickups grant temporary damage immunity; Shield Reboot can prevent a fatal hit, and health drops restore HP.
  • 🪙 Coins & Local Leaderboard: Collect coins mid-run and chase your Top 5 high scores, saved right in your IDE.
  • 🏃 Tight Platforming: Double-jump, dash through danger with i-frames, and rack up a combo multiplier for style points.
  • 🎨 Illustrated worlds: Volumetric 2D characters, dedicated painted panoramas, articulated mechanical and alien bosses, breakable scenery, moving lifts, conveyors and hazardous terrain.
  • 🔇 IDE-friendly: Muted by default, optional music and sound, unified English and Simplified Chinese, pause and safe-segment checkpoints.

"The only plugin where rm -rf / is a valid survival strategy."


Crafted with ❤️, ☕ and a lot of git merge --abort by Phil Zhang.
Check out my portfolio: phil-the-guy.netlify.app
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Merge Hell Runner 2.0.0

A major upgrade to the campaign, combat, and visual experience.

  • Rebuilt worlds with richer scenery, distinct enemies, and multipart bosses.
  • Four playable characters, including the unlockable Night-shift Engineer.
  • Eight-way aiming, crouch fire, and deeper weapon and drone upgrades.
  • Three difficulty levels, longer routes, interactive terrain, and hidden secrets.
  • Improved character animation, enemy navigation, combat feedback, and HUD clarity.
  • English and Simplified Chinese support, improved checkpoints, and optional music and sound—muted by default.

Plus fixes for running-shot range, drone behavior, collisions, and input handling.
